preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x_i <= 10**9 for x_i in coordinates)
preconditions.description: Each city's coordinate must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.
All cities must have distinct coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal total length of cables required to connect the cities.

postconditions.expression: any(cable in cables for cable in byteland_cables) and any(cable in cables for cable in berland_cables)
postconditions.description: The output must ensure that all Byteland and disputed cities are connected, and all Berland and disputed cities are connected.
